implemented_loss_reductions.normalized_alignment: sum latent coordinates; mean valid tokens per utterance; mean batch; sum 3 modalities
implemented_loss_reductions.cross_modal_alignment: same coordinate/token/batch reduction; sum all 6 ordered distinct modality pairs on valid intersections
implemented_loss_reductions.reconstruction: squared Euclidean norm summed over latent coordinates; mean valid tokens per utterance; mean batch; sum 3 modalities; target not detached
implemented_loss_reductions.sentiment_prediction: batch mean L1 on u-only environment
implemented_loss_reductions.invariant_constraint: population variance of 8 environment batch-mean L1 risks
implemented_loss_reductions.decision: Retain current reductions and lambda_dc=0.4. No source-backed enormous-scale reduction was identified.
implemented_loss_reductions.source_limit: KL coordinate sum and squared norm follow equations. Token/batch reductions and DR modality aggregation are independent implementation choices, not recovered official code.
